name: Idaho Shirtsmith Custom Apparel & Embroidery
old_description: Zack And his team did our company apparel and did a fantastic job. We will always use him for any of our apparel needs.
about:
Idaho Shirtsmith Custom Apparel & Embroidery was founded in 2022 in Nampa, Idaho. The business is led by Zack and his team, providing custom apparel and embroidery services to local companies.

The shop offers screen printing, digital transfer printing, commercial embroidery, and laser‑engraved leather patches, along with promotional products such as bags and drinkware. Since opening, the company has completed over 1,000 custom orders for more than 100 businesses.

Its customer base includes Idaho businesses across various sectors; one noted client is Metalhead Mechanical, a mechanical contractor that praised the team’s work. The company emphasizes a three‑step process: request a quote, approve a design, and receive finished apparel on schedule.

Idaho Shirtsmith says it differentiates itself by providing fast quotes, collaborating on designs until the customer approves, and delivering high‑quality apparel on time, every time, while using and recommending top‑tier blank brands.
